rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-028 npm preinstall node setup.mjs spawns detached runtime with NODE_RUNTIME_INIT) OR BIOC(MP-028 proc pid mem read of Runner.Worker process) OR BIOC(MP-028 npm lineage queries instance metadata token and IAM credentials endpoints)) AND (IOC(file-sha256 ChainDrop) OR ABIOC(MP-028 CI runner large HTTPS upload to a rare domain) OR IOC(domain awqhnjewqjkl.icu) OR IOC(domain npm-cache.com)) AND ABIOC(MP-028 STS AssumeRole from a CI runner address after metadata harvest) within 1800s on the same src_host (endpoint alerts project agent_hostname; NGFW records carry endpoint_device_name and src; CloudTrail carries sourceIPAddress, resolved to the host by XSIAM asset IP->host mapping) -> one ChainDrop supply-chain incident.
rules.name: ChainDrop npm worm — endpoint, NGFW and CloudTrail legs on one CI runner
